description: Athlete mentions mild knee soreness after a long run — Dean must NOT set plan_action.injury_hold. Soreness is below the threshold.
inbound_sms: My knee is a little sore after yesterday's long run. Nothing major, just a bit achy. Thinking of taking it easy tomorrow.

ground_truth.notes: PRIMARY TEST: Dean must NOT set injury_hold. Mild post-long-run soreness is well below the threshold — the athlete says 'a bit achy' and is only considering taking it easy, not complete rest. Dean should respond empathetically: acknowledge the soreness, validate taking it easier tomorrow, and give a practical suggestion (e.g., easy effort, shorter run, or rest day). Dean may suggest monitoring it. If plan_action.injury_hold is absent: score 10. If plan_action.injury_hold appears: score 0. plan_action.lighter_week is optional and acceptable here — do not penalize it. All other aspects (pace suggestions, length) are irrelevant for scoring.
